title: Single-file HTML landing page

rubric_compatible_prompts.reason: Historical prompt required the same Book a consultation CTA but did not explicitly state that this task-specific instruction superseded the fixture's default CTA.
rubric_compatible_prompts.prompt: Build a complete, production-quality landing page for Harborline Sleep Education's 45-minute virtual routine-planning consultation ($160) as a single HTML file with inline CSS and no external assets, scripts, fonts, or images. Order the sections the way a cautious first-time visitor decides: what this is and who it is for; how the consultation works; what is included; price; limitations and who it is NOT for (it is educational coaching, not a medical clinic, does not diagnose or treat sleep disorders, is not emergency care, outcomes are not guaranteed, insurance is not represented); common objections; then the next step. Use one primary call to action ('Book a consultation'), appearing at most twice. Use semantic HTML with descriptive headings. Output only the HTML file contents.

prompt: Build a complete, production-quality landing page for Harborline Sleep Education's 45-minute virtual routine-planning consultation ($160) as a single HTML file with inline CSS and no external assets, scripts, fonts, or images. Order the sections the way a cautious first-time visitor decides: what this is and who it is for; how the consultation works; what is included; price; limitations and who it is NOT for (it is educational coaching, not a medical clinic, does not diagnose or treat sleep disorders, is not emergency care, outcomes are not guaranteed, insurance is not represented); common objections; then the next step. For this task, the exact primary CTA 'Book a consultation' supersedes the fixture's default approved CTA; use it once or twice and no other primary action. Use semantic HTML with descriptive headings. Output only the HTML file contents.

completion.check: The response is one complete, parseable HTML document from an HTML5 doctype through the closing html tag, with no Markdown fence.
The HTML uses inline CSS and has no CSS asset references, active content, scripts, images, stylesheets, fonts, media, iframes, embeds, objects, SVG, or canvas assets.
All required sections exist: relevance/who it is for, how it works, what is included, price ($160 for 45 minutes), limitations/not-for, objections, next step.
The exact primary CTA 'Book a consultation' appears once or twice.
No competing primary action is added.

skill_adherence.check: Sections appear in the cautious-visitor order (relevance, mechanism, included value, risk/limitations, objections, next step) with one job and a descriptive heading per section.

No fake urgency, countdown, invented testimonials or reviews, guaranteed outcomes, or hidden terms; disclosures (not medical care, no diagnosis/treatment, not emergency care, outcomes not guaranteed, no insurance representation) are preserved and readable.

best_practices.check: The document has exactly one h1 and ordered heading levels with no skipped levels.
Semantic HTML landmarks (header/main/section/footer or equivalent) organize the page; it is not a div-only document.
The primary action is visually and structurally unmistakable, and copy answers visitor questions concretely instead of vague wellness language.
